note: A company that changed SEC registration number (holding-company reorganisation, merger into a new parent) is keyed here by its current number. Its predecessors' filings are read as its own history. Each entry was checked by hand: the successor's 8-K12B names the same business, the predecessor's last periodic report precedes it, and the successor's earliest balance sheet matches the predecessor's.
